advanced-filter-description: Nsɛm mu yiyiyi a ɛkɔ akyiri no ma wutumi kyerɛw nsɛm a ɛwɔ ahyɛde yi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Fa ntam kwan tetew ahyɛde no mu. Wubetumi ayi afã a woahyɛ da ayɛ nyinaa mu denam wɔn din ne botae a wobɛkyerɛw so. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Field1 == Value1. Hyɛ no nsow: sɛ afã anaa botae no wɔ ntam kwan a, fa hyɛ nsɛm a wɔafa mu sɛnkyerɛnne biako mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔfa agyiraehyɛde (' \/) sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ a, fa \ di kan. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Field1 == I\'m. Wubetumi aka tebea pii abom nso. Sɛ nhwɛso no: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Wɔtaa kenkan ahyɛde nyinaa fi benkum kɔ nifa. Wubetumi de nkahyɛmu asesa ntoatoaso no. Sɛ nhwɛso no: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Wubetumi de regex ahwehwɛ nsɛm afã nso: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Fa Kanboard JSON a wɔayi no bata ha: ade a ɛwɔ "columns" (anaa adwuma a ɛwɔ column_name) ne "tasks" din a wɔahyehyɛ (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, na tasks no bɛyɛ kaad.
import-board-instruction-deck: Paste a NextCloud Deck bɔɔd JSON (a bɔɔd ne "stacks", each stack carrying its "cards"). Stacks become nhyehyɛes ne kaads become kaads.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Fa OpenProject work-packages kuw JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages) bɔ ha. Tebea ahorow no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, na adwuma akuw no bɛyɛ kaad.
import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become kaads grouped kɔ Bue / To mud nhyehyɛes.
import-board-instruction-asana: Fa Asana adwuma JSON a wɔayi no bata ha ({ "data": [...] } a efi Asana nsɛm a wɔayi anaa GET /tasks mu). Wɔkyekyɛ adwuma no mu afã (memberships); adwuma a wɔawie no kɔ Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Fa ZenKit din a wɔahyehyɛ JSON a wɔayi no bata ha ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, na items no bɛyɛ kaad.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Fa markdown adwuma nhyehyɛe krataa (kwan a markdown-kanban nnwinnade te sɛ Obsidian Kanban de di dwuma): "## List din" ntitire, ne "- [ ]"/"- [x]" nneɛma wɔ ase. Ntitire bɛyɛ nkrataa na nneɛma bɛyɛ kaad; bullet list a checkbox nni mu nso betumi akɔ mu, sɛ kaad a ɛda hɔ.
import-board-instruction-leo: Fa Leo nhyehyɛe (.leo fael) no bata ha. Afã a ɛwɔ soro paa no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, afã a ɛwɔ wɔn ase pɛɛ no bɛyɛ kaad, na afã no mu nsɛm bɛyɛ kaad no nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Afã a ɛwɔ ase kɔ akyiri no bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso. Wɔde afã a wɔahyɛ no agyirae ba sɛ nea wɔawie.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Fa todo.txt fael bi bata ha: adwuma baako wɔ nkyekyɛmu biara mu, sɛnea todo.txt dwumadi ne dwumadi a ɛne no hyia kyerɛw no. Nnwuma a wɔawie ("x") kɔ Awie, +project ne @context yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, (A) yɛ ade a ɛdi kan ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, na due: ne t: yɛ da a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwie ne da a wɔfi ase.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Fa nea efi task export mu ba no bata ha: JSON nhyehyɛe anaa adwuma baako wɔ nkyerɛwde fã biara mu. Nnwuma a wɔawie kɔ Done, project ne priority dan nsɛnkyerɛnne, annotations dan nsɛm a wɔka, na depends dan ahotoso wɔ nnwuma a esiw wɔn kwan so.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Yi .boardarchive fael no fi zip mu na fa board.jsonl a ɛwɔ bɔɔd no mu nsɛm bata ha, ɛne nkyerɛwde a ɛkyerɛ nkyerɛase no anaa ɛno nni mu. Bɔɔd no hwɛbea mu kuwkyekyɛ su dan nhyehyɛe, paw su afoforo dan nsɛnkyerɛnne, nkyerɛwee ne adaka a wɔhyɛ no agyirae no afã dan nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, na wɔkora nsɛm a wɔka no so. Wɔmfa mfonini ne fael a wɔde abata ho no mma mu.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-trello: Wɔ wo Trello bɔɔd mu no, kɔ 'Menu', afei 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', na kɔpi nsɛm a ebefi mu aba no.
import-board-instruction-csv: Paste wɔ wo Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) .

import-board-instruction-excel: Paw .xlsx akontaabu kratafa a ɛte sɛ WeKan de (ɛwɔ afã koro a Excel nsɛm a woyi no wɔ: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, nna ne afã a woahyɛ da ayɛ). Nkyerɛw a edi kan no yɛ asɛmti.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaad a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie wɔ nna *<n>* anaa nea ennu saa mu fi seesei. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ kyerɛ kaad a ne bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie atwam no nyinaa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaads which were yɛɛ *<n>* days ago anaa less

globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - kaad nyinaa, nea ɛwɔ adekorabea ne nea enni adekorabea

globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Wɔde ahyɛde a ɛwɔ ɔkwan koro mu bom wɔ *OR* kwan so. Kaad a ɛne emu tebea biara hyia no bɛba.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` bɛma kaad a ɛwɔ din a wɔahyehyɛ a wɔfrɛ no *Blocked* anaa *Available* mu aba.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Wɔde ahyɛde a ɛsono emu biara bom wɔ *AND* kwan so. Kaad a ɛne ahyɛde ahorow no nyinaa hyia nkutoo na ɛba. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` de kaad a ɛwɔ *Available* din no mu a ɛwɔ *red* agyiraehyɛde nkutoo ba.

cron-migrations-resumed: Wɔasan atoa nsɛm a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo no so yiye
cron-migrations-retried: Wɔasan asɔ nsɛm a wɔantumi amfa ankɔ baabi foforo no ahwɛ yiye
filesystem-enabled-description: Fa fael nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ afiri yi so no sie fael
s3-minio-storage-description: Nneɛma akorabea a ɛne S3 yɛ adwuma: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces ne afoforo.
s3-force-path-style: Hyɛ sɛ wɔmfa path-style URL nni dwuma
s3-force-path-style-description: MinIO ne sɛɛva dodow no ara a ɛne S3 yɛ adwuma na ɛnyɛ AWS no hia eyi.
azure-connection-string-description: Ɛnyɛ ahyɛde: fa nkitahodi nsɛm a edi mu di dwuma si akontaabu din ne safoa ananmu.
database-migration: Nsɛm akorabea no nsɛm a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo
database-migration-description: Fa nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw (biribiara gye nneɛma a wɔde abata ho ne wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini a ɛka fael nhyehyɛe no mu) kɔ MongoDB ne FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ntam. Ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm akorabea foforo no yɛ adwuma na wotumi du ho (port a wɔahyɛ dedaw: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; fa WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL sesa no). Sɛ ewie a, ma MONGO_URL nkyerɛ nsɛm akorabea foforo no na san hyɛ WeKan ase (wɔ Snap so: snap set wekan database=ferretdb anaa =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Fa nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no kɔ FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Fa nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no kɔ MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kɔpi nsɛm akuw a wɔakyerɛw no nyinaa kɔ __db__? Nneɛma a wɔde abata ho ne wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini a ɛwɔ fael nhyehyɛe mu no nsesa. Ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm akorabea a wɔde rekɔ no yɛ adwuma.
database-migration-done: Wɔawie nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo no.
sandstorm-migration-description: Sɛ WeKan yɛ adwuma wɔ Sandstorm grain mu a, bere a wɔhyɛ ase nea edi kan no, wɔde ne MongoDB 3 nsɛm akorabea dedaw no kɔ FerretDB v1 (SQLite), na wɔde nneɛma a wɔde abata ho ne wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini fi nsɛm akorabea no mu kɔ grain no files/attachments ne files/avatars fael akuw mu. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔde kɔɔ baabi foforo no yɛɛ yiye ne disk so baabi dodow a MongoDB fael dedaw no da so de di dwuma wɔ grain no mu, na ɛma wutumi popa saa fael no ma baabi da hɔ.
sandstorm-migration-status: Nsɛm a wɔde rekɔ baabi foforo no tebea
sandstorm-migration-failed: Mfomso bi sii wɔ dwumadi yi mu
sandstorm-migration-pending: Wɔnnya mfa nsɛm no nkɔɔ baabi foforo
sandstorm-disk-usage: Disk so baabi a wɔde adi dwuma
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: MongoDB 3 nsɛm akorabea fael a wɔnsesae
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Popa MongoDB nsɛm akorabea fael ankasa no
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Sɛ nsɛm a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo no yɛ yiye a, nsɛm no wɔ FerretDB ne fael nhyehyɛe no mu, enti wubetumi apopa MongoDB 3 nsɛm akorabea fael dedaw no ama grain disk so baabi ada hɔ. Wuntumi nsan nyi eyi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Popa MongoDB 3 nsɛm akorabea fael no na ma disk so baabi nna hɔ? Wɔde nsɛm no akɔ FerretDB ne fael nhyehyɛe no mu dedaw. Wuntumi nsan nyi eyi.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Wɔapopa MongoDB nsɛm akorabea fael ankasa no; beae a ada hɔ
features-desc: Nneɛma a WeKan ma wo kwan ma wopaw sɛ wode bɛyɛ adwuma. Ade a wɔanhyɛ no agyirae no, wɔde sie afi wɔn a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa anim. Wɔkora ne data so, na tumi a wɔde ama no nsesa.
feature-views-table-desc: Bɔɔd no sɛ kaad pon a wobetumi ahyehyɛ.
feature-views-overview-desc: Akontaabu, kyekyɛ mu sɛnea onipa a wɔde adwuma ama no te, adwuma ho nhyehyɛe, nsɛm bɔɔd ne bɔɔd kɛse.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Adwuma a aka wɔ ade a wɔreyɛ no ho, adwumayɛ bere ntiantiaa, saa bere no ho amanneɛbɔ ne adwumayɛ ahoɔhare.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Adwuma a aka, adwuma a wɔawie, adwuma nantew a wɔaboaboa ano, adwumayɛ bere ne twɛntwɛn bere, adwuma a wɔawie dodow, bere a adwuma de atwɛn, akwanside, Monte Carlo ne adwuma nantew ho susudua afoforo.
feature-views-map-desc: Kaad ahorow sɛ agyiraehyɛde wɔ mfonini a wɔde akɔ so.
feature-approval-required: Ma nneɛma a WeKan foforoyɛ de ba no ntumi nyɛ adwuma kosi sɛ ɔhwɛfo bɛma wɔayɛ adwuma
feature-preview-admins: Ahwɛfo hu nneɛma a wɔadum no, na wɔasɔ ahwɛ ansa
feature-pilot-users: Wɔn a wɔde sɔ hwɛ a wɔn nso hu nneɛma a wɔadum no
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma din, fa koma tetew mu
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Wɔasie. Wɔanhu wɔn a wɔde di dwuma din yi:
card-field-visibility-desc: Afã a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Kaad a bɔɔd ahorow betumi akyerɛ. Sɛ wɔyi agyiraehyɛde no fi ɔfã bi so a, wɔde saa ɔfã no sie wɔ kaad nyinaa, kaad nketewa ne Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Kaad mu wɔ bɔɔd nyinaa so. Kaad ho nsɛm ne bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ nsesa. Sɛ wɔsan hyɛ no agyirae a, bɔɔd biara da adi sɛnea wɔhyehyɛɛ no kan no. Bɔɔd biara wɔ n'afã nhyehyɛeɛ ankasa.
features-performance: Sɛnea dwumadi no yɛ adwuma yiye
cards-loading-auto: Ɛno ankasa (kaad a wohia nkutoo ma bɔɔd akɛse)
cards-loading-lazy: Kaad a wohia nkutoo (nea wohu nkutoo)
cards-loading-description: WeKan ankasa de bɔɔd kaad ba: bɔɔd kɛse (a ɛboro kɛseyɛ ano a wɔahyɛ) de kaad a wohu seesei nkutoo ba (wotwe a, ɛtoa so) ne dodow a ɛsesa ntɛm, enti ɛyɛ ntɛm na ɛde memory ne nkitahodi ahoɔden kakraa bi di dwuma. Bɔɔd nketewa de kaad nyinaa ba ma dwumadi nyinaa yɛ mmerɛw. Biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wohyehyɛ. Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe no so betumi de CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ne CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD nhyehyɛe ahorow ahyɛ ɔkwan bi.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Kaad kakraa bi a wɔde ba bere a ɛho hia no da so wɔ sɔhwɛ mu: kaad dodow ne adwuma a ɛrekɔ so ano no yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nanso Kalenda/Pon/Gantt ne nneɛma pii a wɔpaw no fa kaad a wɔde aba dedaw no nkutoo ho. Sɛ wosesa eyi a, san bue bɔɔd a abue no.
render-links-as-plain-text: Kyerɛ link sɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw kɛkɛ
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, link nyinaa (markdown link te sɛ [label](url) ne HTML <a href> agyiraehyɛde) da adi bere nyinaa sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ a wuntumi mmia so wɔ nsɛm afã biara mu (bɔɔd ne kaad asɛmti, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, adwenkyerɛ, nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ho din ne nea ɛkeka ho). Eyi siw link a ɛdaadaa no ano. Wɔadum fi mfiase, enti wotumi mia link so.
always-show-code-as-text-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔmfa nsɛm no nkyerɛ sɛ markdown anaa HTML da: wɔkyerɛ nsɛm no fibea nyinaa sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ wɔ afã biara mu (bɔɔd ne kaad asɛmti, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, adwenkyerɛ, nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ho din ne nea ɛkeka ho). Eyi da nsɛm a ahintaw adi — HTML adwenkyerɛ (<!-- -->), baabi a markdown link kɔ, JavaScript ne koodu foforo biara — enti koodu nyinaa da adi bere nyinaa, wuntumi mmia so, na ɛnyɛ adwuma. Wɔadum fi mfiase, enti wɔkyerɛ markdown sɛnea ɛtaa te.
disable-all-import: Dum nsɛm a wɔde ba mu no nyinaa
disable-all-import-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔadum nsɛm a wɔde ba mu no nyinaa: bɔɔd a wɔde fi WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne Forgejo ba mu, ne bɔɔd a wɔyɛ bi foforo. Wɔde nea wubetumi apaw de aba mu no sie, na som afiri no po adesrɛ biara sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm mmra mu. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-all-export: Dum nsɛm a woyi kɔ abɔnten no nyinaa
disable-all-export-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔadum nsɛm a woyi kɔ abɔnten no nyinaa: bɔɔd a woyi sɛ WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, anaa kɔ NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ne ade biako a wɔde abata ho a woyi kɔ abɔnten. Wɔde nea wubetumi apaw de ayi akɔ abɔnten no sie, na som afiri no po adesrɛ biara sɛ wonyi nsɛm nkɔ abɔnten. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-import-avatars: Dum wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini a wɔde ba mu
disable-import-avatars-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔmfa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini mmra mu da. Eyi ka WeKan JSON, Trello ne mfonini a wɔde fi abɔnten nokwaredi nhyehyɛe ba bere a wɔkɔ mu (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Wɔda so de din ne nsɛm foforo ba mu; mfonini nkutoo na wɔgyae. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-export-avatars: Dum wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini a woyi kɔ abɔnten
disable-export-avatars-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔmfa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini nka bɔɔd a woyi kɔ abɔnten no ho da (WeKan JSON ne CSV). Wɔda so yi din ne nsɛm foforo kɔ abɔnten; mfonini nkutoo na wɔayi afi mu. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
anonymize-import-users: Yi nnipa a wɔde wɔn ba mu no din ankasa fi hɔ
anonymize-import-users-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, WeKan JSON bɔɔd a wɔde ba mu no de din a wɔakan (user1, user2, ...) si obiara din, ne din nyinaa ne din mfiase nkyerɛwde ananmu, yi ne mfonini fi hɔ, na san kyerɛw @username a wɔabɔ din (ne requested-by / assigned-by afã) wɔ kaad ne adwenkyerɛ mu. Wɔnsie obiara din ankasa a efi bɔɔd no mu. Asɛmfua "user" no di nea ɔde nsɛm no ba mu no kasa akyi. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
anonymize-export-users: Yi nnipa a woyi wɔn nsɛm kɔ abɔnten no din ankasa fi hɔ
anonymize-export-users-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, bɔɔd a woyi kɔ abɔnten no de din a wɔakan (user1, user2, ...) si obiara din, ne din nyinaa ne din mfiase nkyerɛwde ananmu, yi ne mfonini fi hɔ, na san kyerɛw @username a wɔabɔ din (ne requested-by / assigned-by afã) wɔ kaad ne adwenkyerɛ mu. Fael a woyi no nkura obiara din ankasa. Asɛmfua "user" no di nea oyi nsɛm no no kasa akyi. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
anonymize-account: Yi akontaabu no ho din ankasa fi hɔ
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Wopɛ sɛ woyi akontaabu yi ho din ankasa fi hɔ ampa? Eyi de din a ɛnkyerɛ onipa no si ne din, ne din nyinaa ne email address ananmu korakora, yi ne mfonini fi hɔ, na dum mu a ɔbɛkɔ. Ɛnte sɛ popa: bɔɔd, kaad ne adwenkyerɛ kura wɔn abakɔsɛm na ɛda so kyerɛ akontaabu yi, nanso ɛnkyerɛ ne din ankasa. Wuntumi nsan nyi adeyɛ yi.
disable-activities-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔntwerɛ dwumadi kyerɛwtohɔ na wɔnnkyerɛ wɔ baabiara da (bɔɔd no nkyɛn ne kaad dwumadi afã). Wɔnkora nea ɔyɛɛ biribi no ho abakɔsɛm so. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-notifications-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, WeKan mmɔ akyidi amanneɛ wɔ dwumadi biara ho da (wɔ app mu, email anaa ɔsom foforo mu). Wobetumi akɔ so akyerɛw dwumadi no (gye sɛ wɔadum ɛno nso wɔ soro); amanneɛbɔ nkutoo na wɔasiw ano. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-watch-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔadum akyidi no — wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ntumi mpaw sɛ wɔbɛgye bɔɔd, din a wɔahyehyɛ anaa kaad ho amanneɛbɔ, na wɔpo mmɔden biara sɛ wɔbɛsesa akyidi dodow. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
backup-description: Kora fael a wɔde aka ho, ahyɛnsode mfonini ne/anaa nsɛm ho mfonini so (nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a ɛnyɛ fael a wɔde aka ho anaa ahyɛnsode mfonini nyinaa). Wɔde .zip no kɔ akorae a wɔapaw no tẽẽ; wɔnyɛ fael a ɛbɛtena hɔ bere tiaa bi. Wɔkora no so sɛ backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, a YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ne /data wɔ mu. Intanɛt so akorae (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) de akwanhyɛ nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ wɔn akorae ntab mu no na ɛyɛ adwuma.
backup-scope: Nea wɔde bɛka nsɛm a wɔkora so no ho
backup-scope-description: Nhyehyɛe yi nyinaa anaa Ahyehyɛde biako. Ahyehyɛde bi nsɛm a wɔakora so no kura ne bɔɔd ne biribiara a ɛwɔ so, a nneɛma a wɔde abata saa bɔɔd no ho ka ho — nanso nnipa akontaabu ne nhyehyɛe no ankasa nhyehyɛe nka ho, efisɛ Ahyehyɛde biara kyɛ saa nneɛma no. Ahyehyɛde bi nsɛm a wɔakora so a wɔsan de ba no kyerɛw bɔɔd a saa Ahyehyɛde no wɔ nkutoo so.
theme-override-all-tenants: Nsakrae a ɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔkyɛ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa de ananmu
backup-now: Kora nsɛm no bi so seesei
backup-done: Wɔawie nsɛm no bi a wɔkora so
backup-schedule: Nsɛm no bi a wɔkora so a wɔahyɛ ho bere
continuous-backup: Nsɛm ho mfonini a wɔkora so bere nyinaa
continuous-backup-description: Ɛde nsakrae biara a ɛba nsɛm siebea, fael a wɔde aka ho, ahyɛnsode mfonini ne dwumadi kyerɛwtohɔ mu kɔ fael akorae wɔ sikɔne kakraa bi mu, na wɔatumi asan de tebea a na ɛwɔ bere biara mu aba. Ɛne nsɛm akora a wɔahyɛ bere ama no no yɛ adwuma; ɛno na ɛyɛ nsɛm nyinaa ho mfonini.
continuous-backup-enabled: Ma nsɛm ho mfonini akora a ɛkɔ so bere nyinaa nyɛ adwuma wɔ sɛva yi so
continuous-backup-target: Fael akorae a wɔde bɛkɔ (ɔkwan a edi mu wɔ disk foforo, nkitahodi so akorae anaa rclone akorae a wɔde abɔ ho so)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (nsakrae biara, bere a ɛsi no ara)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: SQLite nkratafa (nkratafa a asesa wɔ bere biara a wɔahyɛ mu)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (dwumadi a wubetumi apaw de ahyɛ mu)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nsɛm siebea dwumadi biara ntumi nyɛ adwuma wɔ sɛva yi so
continuous-backup-encrypt: Fa kokoam koodu kata mfonini a wɔakora so no so (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Kokoam koodu safe fael (ɔkwan a edi mu wɔ fael akorae a wɔde bɛkɔ no akyi; nkyerɛwde 64 a ɛwɔ akontaabu a ne nnyinaso yɛ 16 mu anaa kokoam kasamu a ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde 16 anaa nea ɛboro saa). Kora bi so: sɛ fael yi nni hɔ a, wɔrentumi mfa mfonini a wɔakora so no mma bio.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Mmfa nkɔ baabiara (fael akorae a wɔde bɛkɔ no nkutoo)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Fael akorae a ɛwɔ akora ade no mu
continuous-backup-fetched: Wɔafa fael ahorow no afi omununkum no mu
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Litestream dwumadi fael (ɔkwan a edi mu)
continuous-backup-restore-points: Mmere a wobetumi asan de aba
continuous-backup-restore-to: San fa tebea no bra wɔ (da ne bere)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite nsɛm siebea fael (wɔyɛ wɔ mfonini a wɔakora so no nkyɛn, wɔntwerɛ ngu fael a wɔde reyɛ adwuma no so da)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Fa SQLite nsɛm siebea a wɔasan ayɛ no si hɔ bere a wɔbɛsan afi nhyehyɛe no ase bio no (wɔbɛkora nsɛm siebea dedaw a wɔasesa no so)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: San fa mfonini kuw a wɔapaw no bra wɔ bere a wɔapaw no mu? Nsɛm ho mfonini akora a ɛkɔ so bere nyinaa no begyina kakra bere a wɔresan de aba no.
continuous-backup-saved: Wɔasie nsɛm ho mfonini akora a ɛkɔ so bere nyinaa nhyehyɛe
backup-restore-mode: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so san de ba
backup-restore-add-missing: Fa nsɛm a enni hɔ nkutoo ka ho
backup-restore-replace-all: Fa si nsɛm no nyinaa ananmu
backup-restore-select-first: Di kan paw nsɛso a wɔasie fi din a wɔahyehyɛ no mu.
backup-restore-confirm: San fa nsɛm ho mfonini a wɔapaw no bra? Wɔde fael a wɔde aka ho ne ahyɛnsode mfonini bɛhyɛ fael nhyehyɛe no mu, na wɔde nsɛm no ahyɛ nsɛm siebea no mu sɛnea ɔkwan a wɔapaw no kyerɛ.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ɛnyɛ ahyɛde: ɔkwan a service account JSON safoa fael no da so wɔ sɛɛva no so.
gcs-credentials-description: Ɛnyɛ ahyɛde: fa service account JSON safoa no bɔ ha. Gyae ha hɔ kwa na fa safoa fael no anaa nsɛm a wɔahyɛ dedaw a wɔde kɔ mu no di dwuma.
gcs-permissions-note: Ma WeKan service account no kwan sɛ ɛkenkan na ɛkyerɛw wɔ akorabea no mu: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wo akorabea → Permissions → Grant access. Wɔ "New principals" mu no, fa service account email no bɔ hɔ — "client_email" botae a ɛwɔ wo JSON safoa mu no — afei paw "Storage Object Admin" dwumadi na mia Save so.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Gyae ha hɔ kwa na kura botae a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no mu.
azure-account-name-description: Wo Azure Storage akontaabu no din.
azure-container-description: Blob akorabea a wɔde fael besie mu.
gcs-project-id-description: Wo Google Cloud adwuma no ID.
gcs-bucket-description: Cloud Storage akorabea a wɔde fael besie mu no din.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: gyae ha hɔ kwa (ɛde ɔmantam no nkitahodi awiei beae di dwuma). Akorabea a ɛne S3 yɛ adwuma: fa Endpoint URL a ɛwɔ wo MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces nhyehyɛe beae no.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wo bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wo bucket din (anaa Yɛ bucket → Bucket din).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → wo de → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → paw 'Application running outside AWS' sɛ nea wode bɛyɛ → Create access key. Wɔkyerɛ no sɛ 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Ɛwɔ beae koro no ara a Access key ID wɔ; wɔkyerɛ 'Secret access key' pɛnkoro bere a wɔyɛ safoa no — kɔpi no saa bere no (anaa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → w’akontaabu → din a wɔakyerɛ wɔ soro (ɛwɔ Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name nso).

stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.

interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.

interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
